CR1.label: Content coverage & indexing

CR1.1.label: Journal not found in Scopus
CR1.1.description: Customer reports that a specific journal title does not appear in Scopus search results or is not indexed. Includes questions about why a journal is missing and when/if it will be added.

CR1.2.label: Journal indexing application or status
CR1.2.description: Enquiries about the process of applying for Scopus indexing, the status of a pending application, or the criteria for journal evaluation by the Content Selection and Advisory Board (CSAB).

CR1.3.label: Journal discontinued or under re-evaluation
CR1.3.description: Customer asks about a journal that was previously indexed but has been discontinued, flagged, or placed under re-evaluation. Includes questions about content suppression or title warnings.

CR1.4.label: Missing articles or issues
CR1.4.description: Specific articles, issues, or volumes that should be in Scopus (journal is indexed) but are not appearing. Includes delays in content loading after publication.

CR1.5.label: Conference proceedings coverage
CR1.5.description: Questions about coverage of specific conference proceedings, conference series indexing, or missing conference papers in Scopus.

CR1.6.label: Book or book series coverage
CR1.6.description: Enquiries about book series, edited volumes, or book chapters in Scopus — whether they're covered, how to get them indexed, or why they're missing.

CR1.7.label: Other content coverage issue
CR1.7.description: Content coverage enquiries not fitting the categories above, including trade publications, preprints, or non-standard content types.

CR1.8.label: Article-in-Press (AiP) visibility or missing
CR1.8.description: Customer reports their AiP has not appeared in Scopus within the expected 4-day FTP delivery window. Use when customer specifically references AiP, pre-publication, or accepted manuscript status. Links to policy PA10.

CR1.description: Enquiries about whether specific journals, articles, conference proceedings, or book series are covered in Scopus, requests about new content indexing, and questions about content discontinuation or re-evaluation.

CR2.label: Citations & references

CR2.1.label: Incorrect citation count
CR2.1.description: Customer reports that the citation count for a specific article or author is wrong — either too high (counting duplicates or erroneous citations) or too low (missing legitimate citations).

CR2.2.label: Missing citations or cited-by links
CR2.2.description: Specific citations that should appear in Scopus but are missing. The citing article exists in Scopus but the citation link to the cited article is broken or absent.

CR2.3.label: Incorrect reference linking
CR2.3.description: References in an article's reference list are linked to the wrong Scopus record, or reference links are broken. Includes DOI mismatch issues.

CR2.4.label: Citation data discrepancy with other sources
CR2.4.description: Customer compares Scopus citation data with Google Scholar, Web of Science, CrossRef, or publisher data and finds discrepancies. Requests for explanation or correction.

CR2.5.label: Other citation issue
CR2.5.description: Citation or reference issues not fitting the categories above.

CR2.description: Issues related to citation counts, citation links, reference lists, cited-by data, and discrepancies between Scopus citation data and other sources.

CR3.label: Author profiles & identification

CR3.1.label: Author profile merge request
CR3.1.description: Customer has multiple Scopus Author IDs that need to be merged into one profile. The same person appears as different authors in Scopus due to name variations, affiliation changes, or system errors.

CR3.2.label: Author profile split request
CR3.2.description: Customer's Scopus Author ID incorrectly contains publications from a different author with a similar name. The profile needs to be split to remove misattributed publications.

CR3.3.label: Wrong affiliation on author profile
CR3.3.description: The author's current or historical affiliation is displayed incorrectly on their Scopus profile. Includes outdated affiliations and missing affiliation history.

CR3.4.label: ORCID linking or synchronisation issue
CR3.4.description: Problems connecting ORCID iD to Scopus profile, synchronisation failures between ORCID and Scopus, or discrepancies between ORCID and Scopus publication lists.

CR3.5.label: Missing publications on author profile
CR3.5.description: Publications that exist in Scopus but are not attributed to the correct author profile. Includes articles missing from an author's publication list despite being indexed.

CR3.6.label: Other author profile issue
CR3.6.description: Author profile issues not fitting the categories above, including h-index disputes at the author level, name format changes, or deceased author profile management.

CR3.description: Issues related to Scopus Author IDs, author profiles, name disambiguation, profile merging or splitting, ORCID linking, and author-level data accuracy.

CR4.label: Metrics, rankings & evaluations

CR4.1.label: CiteScore calculation or value dispute
CR4.1.description: Customer questions or disputes the CiteScore value for a specific journal. Includes requests to understand the calculation methodology, source year ranges, or why the score changed.

CR4.2.label: SJR or SNIP metric query
CR4.2.description: Questions about SCImago Journal Rank (SJR) or Source Normalized Impact per Paper (SNIP) values, methodology, or discrepancies.

CR4.3.label: h-index or author-level metric issue
CR4.3.description: Questions about h-index calculation, discrepancies between Scopus and other sources, or requests to understand how author-level metrics are derived.

CR4.4.label: Journal ranking or quartile classification
CR4.4.description: Questions about journal subject area classifications, quartile assignments (Q1–Q4), or requests to change a journal's subject area mapping.

CR4.5.label: Other metrics or evaluation issue
CR4.5.description: Metrics questions not fitting above, including institutional-level analytics, benchmarking queries, or Scopus data use in national evaluation frameworks.

CR4.description: Questions or disputes about Scopus-derived metrics including CiteScore, SJR, SNIP, h-index, journal rankings, and how these metrics are calculated or used for research evaluation.

CR5.label: Data accuracy & corrections

CR5.1.label: Incorrect article metadata
CR5.1.description: Article record has wrong title, abstract, DOI, publication date, page numbers, volume/issue, or document type. Customer requests a correction to the bibliographic record.

CR5.2.label: Retracted or corrected article not updated
CR5.2.description: A retracted article still appears without a retraction notice, or an erratum/corrigendum has been published but the original Scopus record hasn't been updated.

CR5.3.label: Duplicate records
CR5.3.description: The same article appears multiple times in Scopus with different EIDs or record identifiers. Customer requests deduplication.

CR5.4.label: Wrong document type classification
CR5.4.description: An article is classified as the wrong document type (e.g. 'Article' instead of 'Review', 'Letter' instead of 'Editorial'). Affects metrics calculations.

CR5.5.label: Other data accuracy issue
CR5.5.description: Data accuracy issues not fitting above, including ISSN/ISBN errors, publisher name errors, or language classification issues.

CR5.description: Reports of incorrect metadata in Scopus records — wrong titles, abstracts, DOIs, publication dates, page numbers, volume/issue numbers, or other bibliographic data errors.

CR6.label: Search & platform functionality

CR6.1.label: Search returns incorrect or incomplete results
CR6.1.description: Customer's search query returns unexpected results — missing known articles, irrelevant results, or inconsistent results with different search strategies.

CR6.2.label: Alert or saved search not working
CR6.2.description: Search alerts not sending notifications, saved searches not updating, or alert frequency/content issues.

CR6.3.label: Export or download issue
CR6.3.description: Problems exporting search results, downloading citations (RIS, BibTeX, CSV), or exporting to reference managers. Includes API export issues.

CR6.4.label: API access or Scopus API query issue
CR6.4.description: Questions about Scopus APIs (Search, Author, Abstract), API keys, rate limits, query syntax, or API data discrepancies vs the web interface.

CR6.5.label: Other platform functionality issue
CR6.5.description: Platform issues not fitting above, including browser compatibility, mobile access, accessibility, or UI/UX problems.

CR6.description: Issues with Scopus search functionality, API access, alerts, saved searches, export features, and general platform usability. NOT access/authentication issues (see CR7).

CR7.label: Access & subscription

CR7.1.label: Cannot access Scopus or access denied
CR7.1.description: Customer cannot access Scopus at all — login fails, access denied message, or paywall appears despite having a subscription.

CR7.2.label: Institutional subscription or entitlement query
CR7.2.description: Questions about what's included in the institution's Scopus subscription, how to activate access, or entitlement configuration in the admin portal.

CR7.3.label: Remote or off-campus access issue
CR7.3.description: Customer can access Scopus on campus but not remotely. Includes VPN, proxy, and federated authentication (Shibboleth/SAML) issues.

CR7.4.label: Other access issue
CR7.4.description: Access issues not fitting above, including personal Scopus accounts, trial access, and transitional access during subscription renewals.

CR7.description: Issues related to accessing Scopus content, institutional subscriptions, authentication, IP-based access, remote access, and entitlement configuration.

CR8.label: General enquiry & other

CR8.1.label: General product question or how-to
CR8.1.description: Customer asks about Scopus features, capabilities, or how to perform a specific task. Not a problem report — just seeking information.

CR8.2.label: Training or documentation request
CR8.2.description: Requests for Scopus training sessions, user guides, webinars, or documentation for institutional users.

CR8.3.label: Feedback or complaint about Scopus
CR8.3.description: Customer provides feedback, suggestions, or formal complaints about Scopus product quality, service, or policies.

CR8.4.label: Other general enquiry
CR8.4.description: General enquiries not fitting any category above.

CR8.description: General questions about Scopus that don't fit specific categories above, including product capabilities, training requests, feedback, and complaints.
